title: crepidomanes euphlebium
intro: Crepidomanes euphlebium, commonly known as the fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Asia, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Crepidomanes euphlebium include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory effects.
